test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 are written on different faces of a dice. Three different positions of the same dice are shown below. Find the number on the face opposite to the one showing ‘5’. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01a3b6c7157ad4c342f6a36528dc91890b4fe852f110f471eddcd6e5c700bfd3.png]
solution:
From figure 1 and 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/edae7c48e5dcc4aaf41df3e8ecf7400befc505e89de674942a62039c696f639d.png] 

→ Face 1 and 5 are common ⇒ **Face 4 is opposite to Face 6.**

From figure 1 and 3,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7f519aea4b4ec04c2b6acb89a57612d57678103411457c317d0d26833a9102b.png] 

→ Face 1 and 4 are common ⇒ **Face 5 is opposite to Face 3.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"3"**.
